summary: Comprehensive testing of booking cancellation functionality and guest_count removal. All 11 backend tests passed. Frontend UI tests verified cancellation buttons, modals, status badges, and cancellation policy section for vacation rentals.
passed_tests: Owner login successful
Renter login successful
Create property with cancellation_policy (moderate) - verified saved correctly
Create booking WITHOUT guest_count field - works as expected
Renter can request cancellation - status changes to 'cancellation_requested'
Owner can approve cancellation request - status changes to 'cancelled'
Owner can deny cancellation request - status reverts to previous, denial_reason saved
Owner can directly cancel booking - status changes to 'cancelled' with reason
Renter cannot directly cancel (403 Forbidden) - must request cancellation
All cancellation policy options work (flexible, moderate, strict, custom)
Guest count field NOT present in PropertyDetail booking form
Cancellation Policy section NOT shown for long-term rentals
Cancellation Policy section shown for vacation rentals
Custom cancellation policy textarea appears when 'custom' selected
Cancel Booking button visible for owners on pending/confirmed bookings
Request Cancellation button visible for renters on pending/confirmed bookings
Approve/Deny buttons visible for owners on cancellation_requested bookings
Cancellation modal opens with reason textarea
Deny modal opens with denial reason textarea
Status badges display correctly (pending=yellow, cancelled=gray, cancellation_requested=orange)
critical_code_review_comments: BookingCreate model correctly excludes guest_count field
Cancellation endpoints properly check user roles (owner vs renter)
Status transitions handled correctly (pending/confirmed -> cancellation_requested -> cancelled)
Previous status preserved when cancellation is denied
Notifications created for all cancellation actions
Cancellation policy fields only shown for vacation rental type (conditional rendering)
seed_data_creation: Created test bookings during pytest execution for cancellation workflow testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: Cancellation functionality fully tested. Backend endpoints: /api/bookings/{id}/cancel (owner direct), /api/bookings/{id}/request-cancel (renter request), /api/bookings/{id}/approve-cancel (owner approve), /api/bookings/{id}/deny-cancel (owner deny). Frontend shows appropriate buttons based on user role and booking status. Cancellation policy section only appears for vacation rentals in property form.
